import json
for p in ['reports/GEDE01/objdiff-game_fn_801C1600-session-1704.json','reports/GEDE01/objdiff-game_fn_801C1600-session-1704-reloc-strict.json']:
 d=json.load(open(p)); print(p)
 for side in ('left','right'):
  s=next(x for x in d[side]['symbols'] if x['name']=='fn_801C1600'); sec=next(x for x in d[side]['sections'] if x['name']=='.text')
  ins=sum(1 for x in s['instructions'] if x.get('instruction'))
  rel=[(x.get('instruction',{}).get('address','0'),x.get('instruction',{}).get('relocation',{}).get('type_name'),x.get('instruction',{}).get('relocation',{}).get('target_symbol')) for x in s['instructions'] if x.get('instruction',{}).get('relocation',{}).get('type_name') not in (None,'R_PPC_NONE')]
  print(f'{side}: symbol_size={s["size"]} section_size={sec["size"]} instruction_rows={ins} match_percent={s.get("match_percent")} relocations={rel}')
